method.scope: Existing B-region queries, separately for objects and actions; opposite-split observed candidates only
method.schema: Train->Val matches tvrtrain_synonym_pairs.csv exactly; Val->Train uses train_ target column names
method.source_expression: Original raw expression, supported source POS and matching original lemma; literal token-boundary occurrence required
method.synonym_expression: Candidate lemma inflected to original Penn POS using lemminflect; original capitalization retained
method.target_witness: First original opposite-split caption with an actual expression matching candidate lemma and POS category
method.ranking: Alphabetical order of inflected candidate expressions; all candidates, no top-k or semantic score
method.meaning: All shared same-POS synset definitions, joined with |; no context-selected sense
method.review: Lexical candidates only; no contextual equivalence, visual grounding, phrasal-verb or temporal validation; requires_review=True
method.difference_from_reference: The reference applies contextual sense scoring and top-k; this export flattens existing B lexical candidates
method.randomness: No sampling; fixed seed; original query order, sorted alternatives
